name: Hyundai Barcelona Half Marathon by Brooks
summary: A fast, fully urban half marathon through central Barcelona and the Poblenou seafront, welcoming a record 40,000 runners for its 2027 edition.
heroNote: Cheer from the lively streets of Sant Antoni, near Arc de Triomf, or along the Poblenou seafront before the finish beside Parc de la Ciutadella.
specialNote: The race uses staggered starts based on expected pace. Confirm the runner's actual corral start time before planning arrivals.
